correctness.rationale: Reconstructed smoothness: quartic RHS has distinct roots iff t^2!=1; genus3 Picard plane quartic, basis dx/y^2, x dx/y^2, dx/y. Cartier p-semilinearity preserves zero/rank patterns. For p=6m+1, diagonal coefficient polynomials satisfy A=[z^{3m}]Q^{4m}=(t^2-1)^m H and B=[z^{2m}]Q^{4m}=(-1)^m binom(4m,m)(t^2-1)^m, so rank3 for H!=0 and rank1 at H=0. For p=6m+5, Cartier exchanges two basis vectors, with A=[z^{3m+2}]Q^{4m+3}=2(t^2-1)^{m+1}H; rank2 or zero, and semilinear iterates stabilize ranks. H has exact degree m, H(±1)!=0 from binomial coefficients (<p), and satisfies a hypergeometric coefficient ODE forcing simplicity of its roots because m<p. Re-derived coefficient polynomial identities independently for every prime 5..79 (20 primes), including exact degree, nonzero boundaries and gcd(H,H')=1, and specifically p11,t0=H=0 Cartier zero. A finite prime list is corroboration only, not the uniform proof.

value.rationale: The pencil is the natural bielliptic genus-three Picard family already studied geometrically. A single explicit characteristic-dependent Hasse polynomial gives a complete geometric p-rank and a-number stratification uniformly across all p>=5 with the precise number of exceptional smooth parameters and superspecial cases. This resolves a genuine natural invariant, not a table for arbitrary primes; full Newton polygons and geometric moduli remain outside scope.

final_claim: For p>=5 and smooth parameters t in algebraic closure of F_p with t^2 !=1, curves y^3=x^4+2tx^2+1 have exactly H_p(t)=0 exceptional parameters, where degree m=floor((p-1)/6) H_p=[z^m](z^2+2tz+1)^e has m simple nonboundary roots. The Jacobian (p-rank,a-number) strata are (3,0)/(1,2) in p=1 mod6 and (2,1)/(0,3) in p=5 mod6, generic/exceptional respectively.
limitations: Over algebraic closure of F_p; p>=5, t^2 !=1; exceptional count of parameters not isomorphism classes.
Full Newton polygons and Ekedahl-Oort types not classified.
Coefficient proof is characteristic-uniform; finite 20-prime identity checks supplementary.
